correctness.rationale: The signed measure has total variation one and no atoms. For each t the representing measure of evaluation after P is δ_t−h(t)μ, with the two summands mutually singular; taking the supremum of their total variations gives ||P||=1+||h||∞ directly. Equality |μ(h)|=||h||∞ for nonzero h would require opposite constant normalized values on the two open halves, contradicting continuity. Pairing midpoint reflections gives the sharp bound 2 min(R,Lu) for the difference, attained simultaneously by the clipped ramp. Its weighted integral is R−Cα R^(α+2)/L^(α+1) for R≤L/2, otherwise L/L*. This proves feasibility and root uniqueness on the stated branch. Positivity of the density, continuity, and Lipschitz saturation between the two clipping points force the same ramp; at the critical budget endpoint saturation forces slope L and the optimal sup norm fixes the intercept. Let b=α+1 and q=2R/L. The scalar equation is (L/2)[q−q^(b+1)/(b+1)]=1. At q=1 the bracket is b/(b+1) and its deficit at q=1−z is b z²/2+O(z³). Hence R=L*/2−sqrt((L−L*)/b)+O(L−L*). At large L the increasing branch tends to R=1 and substitution gives R−1=Cα L^(−b)+O(L^(−2b)). This yields the unrestricted infimum 2 with nonattainment. The α=0 exact solution L(1−sqrt(1−4/L))/2 also checks both regimes. The frozen checker was inspected but not executed; its reported quadrature checks are bounded, not the proof.
